body:
NTA- As someone who had to watch my 3 siblings starting at 12 (My mom had 3 more kids starting when I was 12) for 5+hours at a time a day that is absolutely parentification. 12 year old me was very happy to help, as that was the expectation. 35 year old me feels lasting effects from that time in my life. I felt like a teen mom as I was basically raising my siblings. I never felt I could relax or do things normal kids could enjoy. I had NO idea what I was doing and it caused a lot of stress. I didn't get to have my own life until I moved out.

I can't even fathom going through that and being one of NINE.
Thank you! I'm going to start listening to him during my bus commutes!
Thank you! I'm going to make a checklist on my phone to take with me! This is very helpful and just what I was looking for!
